data.name: Hurr
data.gender_notes: Hurr is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A free person, not enslaved or bound. The name Hurr carries the meaning “Free” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hurr usually hope their child will grow to embody free and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islam, Hurr is the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who was known for his bravery and unwavering faith.
data.etymology: Hurr belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Free.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hurr total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: حر
in_arabic.meaning: الحرية والشرف العالي والحماية الالهية للعبد
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحر هو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الحرية والشرف العالي، ويرتبط بالحماية الالهية للعبد، حيث يعتبر اسمًا يوحي بالعزة والكرامة، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن العباد المخلصين.

in_urdu.name: حر
in_urdu.meaning: آزادی، اعلیٰ شان، اور الہی حفاظت
in_urdu.long_meaning: حر نام آزادی اور اعلیٰ شان کی علامت ہے، جو الہی حفاظت کے مفہوم سے بھی جڑا ہوا ہے، یہ نام عزت اور کرامت کا احساس دلاتا ہے، اور اسلامی تقالید میں اس کا اہمیت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हर
in_hindi.meaning: स्वतंत्रता, उच्च सम्मान, और ईश्वरीय संरक्षण
in_hindi.long_meaning: हर नाम स्वतंत्रता और उच्च सम्मान का प्रतीक है, जो ईश्वरीय संरक्षण की भावना से भी जुड़ा है, यह नाम गरिमा और प्रतिष्ठा की भावना को दर्शाता है, और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसकी पारंपरिक महत्ता है।

in_pashto.name: حر
in_pashto.meaning: آزادي، لوړ شان، او الهي حفاظت
in_pashto.long_meaning: حر نوم د آزادي او لوړ شان نښه ده، چې د الهي حفاظت مفهوم سره هم تړلی دی، دا نوم د عزت او کرامت احساس ورکوي، او په افغان او پښتون دود کې يې مذهبي او کلتوري اهميت لري.

in_english.name: Hurr
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hurr signifies freedom and high honor, embodying the concept of divine protection. Rooted in Arabic etymology, it reflects a sense of dignity and nobility. Historically, it has been used in Islamic tradition to denote individuals of high moral character and spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hurr carries a unique cultural significance in Islamic history, as it refers to the free and unbound nature of the individual. Historically, Hurr is best known for being a companion of Prophet Muhammad PBUH and for his unwavering dedication to Islam, despite facing numerous hardships and challenges along the way. Hurr's name embodies the spirit of personal freedom, independence, and the courage to stand up for one's beliefs.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper, spiritual level, the name Hurr holds a profound significance as it mirrors the liberation and release from bondage of the soul. It is a reminder that every soul is inherently free and unencumbered by worldly chains, and that our ultimate goal should be to strive towards spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name also serves as an inspiration for us to live our lives with dignity, courage, and unyielding faith in the face of adversity.

historical_references.context: Hurr was known for his poetic skills and his bravery in battle.
